package noder
import("fmt";"encoding/json";"encoding/binary";"os";"strings";"sort";"testing";"IMPORT_TYPES";BODY_TYPES2 "IMPORT_IR";"IMPORT_OBJ";"IMPORT_SRC";"IMPORT_SYS";"IMPORT_TYPECHECK";"IMPORT_PKGBITS";BODY_RUNTIME HEUR_IMPORT IMPORT_BASE)
func TestSyncgoNativeSnapshot(t *testing.T){
 target:=struct{arch string;size int;order binary.ByteOrder}{strings.SplitN(os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET"),"-",2)[0],8,binary.LittleEndian};switch target.arch{case "386":target.size=4;case "mips":target.size=4;target.order=binary.BigEndian;case "ppc64":target.order=binary.BigEndian}
 SETUP
 switch {case strings.HasSuffix(os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET"),"-fips"):LINK.Pkgpath="crypto/internal/fips140/testinit";case strings.HasSuffix(os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET"),"-nooutline"):ND_DEBUG.WrapGlobalMapCtl=1;case strings.HasSuffix(os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET"),"-stressoutline"):ND_DEBUG.WrapGlobalMapCtl=2}
 var out []string
 data,err:=os.ReadFile(BODY_INPUT_PATH);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 pr:=UP.newPkgReader(pkgbits.NewPkgDecoder("example/p",string(data)));UP.localPkgReader=pr
 wanted:=map[string]bool{};for _,s:=range []string{"RecF","RecI","Node","Alias","Rounded","Complex","Add","Closure","Generic","Control","Range","Method","Composite","Calls","Branch","Capture"}{wanted[s]=true}
 for i:=range pr.NumElems(pkgbits.SectionName){r:=pr.newReader(pkgbits.SectionName,index(i),pkgbits.SyncObject1);_,sym:=r.qualifiedIdent();tag:=pkgbits.CodeObj(r.Code(pkgbits.SyncCodeObj));if tag==pkgbits.ObjStub||sym.Pkg!=TY.LocalPkg||!wanted[sym.Name]{continue};n:=pr.objIdx(index(i),nil,nil,false).(*ir.Name);delete(wanted,sym.Name);out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("decl:%v:%v:%v:%v:%t",n.Sym(),n.Op(),n.Type(),n.Val(),n.Alias()));if sym.Name!="init"&&pr.objIdx(index(i),nil,nil,false)!=n{t.Fatal("object cache identity")}}
 if len(wanted)!=0{t.Fatal("missing",wanted)}
 pr.newReader(pkgbits.SectionMeta,pkgbits.PrivateRootIdx,pkgbits.SyncPrivate).pkgInit(TY.LocalPkg,TC.Target)
 BODY_DRAIN
 HEUR_SETUP
 // Supply identical precomputed inlinability metadata to isolate the native
 // heuristics pass. This fixture does not replace production CanInlineFuncs.
 markInline:=func(fn *ir.Func){fn.Inl=&ir.Inline{Cost:50};fn.SetInlinabilityChecked(true)}
 for _,fn:=range TC.Target.Funcs{markInline(fn)}
 for _,fn:=range TC.Target.Funcs{HEUR.AnalyzeFunc(fn,markInline,func(*ir.Func)int32{return 2000},80)}
 for _,fn:=range TC.Target.Funcs{
  if fn.Inl!=nil{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("properties:%v:%x:%s",fn.Sym(),fn.Inl.Properties,inlheur.DeserializeFromString(fn.Inl.Properties)))}
  HEUR.ScoreCalls(fn)
  ir.VisitList(fn.Body,func(n ir.Node){if call,ok:=n.(*ir.CallExpr);ok{score,found:=HEUR.GetCallSiteScore(fn,call);out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("score:%v:%v:%d:%t",fn.Sym(),LINK.PosTable.Pos(call.Pos()),score,found))}})
  HEUR.ScoreCallsCleanup()
 }
 HEUR.TearDown()
 for _,fn:=range TC.Target.Inits {
  out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("init:%v:%t",fn.Sym(),fn.IsPackageInit()))
  if fn.IsPackageInit(){
   for _,stmt:=range fn.Body {out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("before-static:%v",stmt))}
   schedule:=INIT_SCHEDULE
   GRAPH.WithFunc(fn,func(){for _,stmt:=range fn.Body{schedule.StaticInit(stmt)}})
   fn.Body=schedule.Out
   out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("schedule:%d:%d:%d",len(schedule.Plans),len(schedule.Temps),len(schedule.Out)))
  }
 }
 // Exercise the native post-inlining static-folding recognizer using its
 // actual AS2/INLMARK/BLOCK/GOTO/LABEL IR shape, including rejection paths.
 pos:=AUTO_POS
 param:=GRAPH.NewNameAt(pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("inlineParam"),TY.Types[types.TINT]);param.Class=ir.PAUTO
 retvar:=GRAPH.NewNameAt(pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("inlineReturn"),TY.Types[types.TUINT8]);retvar.Class=ir.PAUTO
 label:=TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("inlineEnd")
 args:=GRAPH.NewAssignListStmt(pos,ir.OAS2,[]ir.Node{param},[]ir.Node{GRAPH.NewInt(pos,257)})
 result:=GRAPH.NewConvExpr(pos,ir.OCONV,TY.Types[types.TUINT8],param)
 assign:=GRAPH.NewAssignListStmt(pos,ir.OAS2,[]ir.Node{retvar},[]ir.Node{result})
 block:=GRAPH.NewBlockStmt(pos,[]ir.Node{GRAPH.NewDecl(pos,ir.ODCL,retvar),assign,GRAPH.NewBranchStmt(pos,ir.OGOTO,label)})
 inlined:=GRAPH.NewInlinedCallExpr(pos,[]ir.Node{block,GRAPH.NewLabelStmt(pos,label)},[]ir.Node{retvar});inlined.SetType(TY.Types[types.TUINT8]);inlined.PtrInit().Append(args,GRAPH.NewInlineMarkStmt(pos,1))
 dest:=INIT_STATE.StaticName(TY.Types[types.TUINT8]);fold:=INIT_SCHEDULE
 ND_DEBUG.InlStaticInit=0
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("inline-disabled:%t",fold.StaticAssign(dest,0,inlined,dest.Type())))
 ND_DEBUG.InlStaticInit=1
 param.SetAddrtaken(true);out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("inline-address:%t",fold.StaticAssign(dest,0,inlined,dest.Type())));param.SetAddrtaken(false)
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("inline-fold:%t",fold.StaticAssign(dest,0,inlined,dest.Type())))
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("inline-retained:%t:%v:%x",result.X==param,args.Rhs[0],dest.Linksym().P))
 INIT_STATE.AddKeepRelocations()
 var mapInits []string
 for fn,v:=range INIT_STATE.MapInitToVar {mapInits=append(mapInits,fmt.Sprintf("map-init:%v:%v",fn.Sym(),v.Sym()))};sort.Strings(mapInits);out=append(out,mapInits...)

 for _,fn:=range TC.Target.Funcs{
 if fn.Pos()==(src.XPos{}){t.Fatal("function position missing")}
  out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("fn:%v:%v:%d:%t:%t:%s:%s:%v",fn.Sym(),fn.Type(),fn.Typecheck(),fn.Dupok(),fn.Wrapper(),LINK.PosTable.Pos(fn.Pos()),LINK.PosTable.Pos(fn.Endlineno),fn.Parents))
  for _,m:=range fn.Marks{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("mark:%s:%d",LINK.PosTable.Pos(m.Pos),m.Scope))}
  for _,d:=range fn.Dcl{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("local:%v:%v:%d:%t:%t",d.Sym(),d.Type(),d.Class,d.AutoTemp(),d.Curfn==fn))}
  for _,v:=range fn.ClosureVars{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("capture:%v:%v:%t:%t",v.Sym(),v.Type(),v.Curfn==fn,v.Outer!=nil))}
  for _,stmt:=range fn.Body{ir.Visit(stmt,func(n ir.Node){out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("node:%s:%d:%v:%s:%v",n.Op(),n.Typecheck(),n.Type(),LINK.PosTable.Pos(n.Pos()),n))})}
 }
 for _,typ:=range UP.needWrapperTypes{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("need-wrapper:%v",typ))};for _,typ:=range UP.haveWrapperTypes{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("have-wrapper:%v",typ))}
 for _,entry:=range UP.needMethodValueWrappers{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("method-value:%v:%v",entry.rcvr,entry.method.Sym))}
 symbols:=append([]*obj.LSym(nil),LINK.Data...);seen:=map[*obj.LSym]bool{};for _,s:=range symbols{seen[s]=true};for _,n:=range TC.Target.Externs{if n.Op()==ir.ONAME{sym:=n.Linksym();if !seen[sym]{symbols=append(symbols,sym);seen[sym]=true}}};sort.Slice(symbols,func(i,j int)bool{return symbols[i].Name<symbols[j].Name});for _,s:=range symbols{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("symbol:%s:%v:%d:%x:%d",s.Name,s.Type,s.Size,s.P,uint32(s.Attribute)));for _,r:=range s.R{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("reloc:%v:%d:%d:%s:%v:%d",r.Type,r.Off,r.Siz,r.Sym.Name,r.Sym.ABI(),r.Add))}}
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("end:%d:%d:%t",len(UP.todoBodies),len(UP.todoDicts),GRAPH.CurFunc==nil))
 bytes,_:=json.Marshal(out);fmt.Printf("SYNCGO_IR=%s\n",bytes)
}
